charts.question: Prediction of the manual protocol in held-out PSUs
charts.supported_finding: Every calibration excludes the complete test sampling unit.
charts.interpretation_boundary: The device and examiner change together. Weighted results describe adults with paired examination records; threshold crossings are survey classifications, not new clinical diagnoses.
